params.serviceOwner: Individual that creates and controls a service.

params.newManager: Address of a new unit manager.

params.serviceOwner: Individual that creates and controls a service.

deploy(address,uint256,address,bytes).details: Creates multisig instance controlled by the set of service agent instances and deploys the service.

params.data: Data payload for the multisig creation.
params.serviceOwner: Individual that creates and controls a service.

returns._0: true if the unit exists, false otherwise.

returns.agentInstances: Pre-allocated list of agent instance addresses.

getAgentParams(uint256).details: Gets service agent parameters: number of agent instances (slots) and a bond amount.

returns.agentParams: Set of agent parameters for each canonical agent Id.
returns.numAgentIds: Number of canonical agent Ids in the service.

getInstancesForAgentId(uint256,uint256).details: Lists all the instances of a given canonical agent Id if the service.

returns.agentInstances: Set of agent instances for a specified canonical agent Id.

getOperatorBalance(address,uint256).details: Gets the operator's balance in a specific service.

returns.configHashes: The list of previous component hashes (excluding the current one).

getUnitIdsOfService(uint8,uint256).details: Gets the full set of linearized components / canonical agent Ids for a specified service.

params.agentIds: Canonical Ids of the agent correspondent to the agent instance.

returns.refund: Refund to return to the service owner.

tokenByIndex(uint256).details: Gets the valid unit Id from the provided index.

unbond(address,uint256).details: Unbonds agent instances of the operator from the service.

returns.refund: The amount of refund returned to the operator.
